title: Contradiction on relational-db, processors
content:
## Involved claims

- The relational-DB processor spec describes an API the code no longer has: onStrands, InternalTransmitterUpdate, PowerhouseDB and packages/document-drive are all gone at v6.2.2-dev.74 — `97c3a924-0ba9-4b89-86f7-b7a5747d41a7`
- RelationalDbProcessor provides a type-safe base class with per-drive namespace isolation and lifecycle migration hooks — `f7e6d116-bd5d-4052-9f2a-974e4d7cb7e2`

## Why this exists

A `CONTRADICTS` relationship was recorded between these two notes at 2026-09-03T07:30:30.172Z. The vault treats a recorded contradiction as an open question, not a fact to leave implicit: until someone resolves or dissolves this tension, both claims stand and readers should see that they disagree.

## How to close it

- **Resolve** when one claim is correct: say which, and consider `SUPERSEDES` on the winner.
- **Dissolve** when both are right in different scopes: state the boundary in each note's content.
resolution: Resolved in favour of the code. The spec's claim that the base class discovers and applies migrations automatically does not hold at v6.2.2-dev.74: the generated relational-DB processor template overrides initAndUpgrade() and calls up(this.relationalDb) itself. Namespace isolation and the type-safe query surface do hold. The older note has been corrected in place rather than archived, since only its lifecycle claim was wrong.
description: “The relational-DB processor spec describes an API the code no longer has: onStrands, InternalTransmitterUpdate, PowerhouseDB and packages/d…” contradicts “RelationalDbProcessor provides a type-safe base class with per-drive namespace isolation and lifecycle migration hooks”. Opened automatically from a CONTRADICTS link — resolve if one side is right, dissolve if both hold in different contexts.
